Analytical data professional focused on transforming large datasets into actionable business insights using SQL, Python and visualization tools.

Senior Data Analyst, Infosys — Jun 2015 - Jun 2026
Led analytics for a cross-functional product quality initiative, building automated data pipelines and dashboards to track key operational KPIs. Implemented SQL-based ETL processes that consolidated data from transactional systems and reduced report generation time by 60%. Developed Python 3 scripts using pandas to clean and enrich event-level data, enabling cohort analyses that informed prioritization of feature fixes. Delivered interactive PowerBI dashboards for stakeholders and documented workflows and issue tickets in Jira to drive resolution cycles.

Data Analyst, Dream11 — Dec 2012 - May 2015
Owned weekly and ad-hoc analytical requests to support marketing and retention teams. Wrote complex SQL queries to segment users and measure campaign lift, contributing to a 12% improvement in retention for targeted cohorts. Built Excel models and dashboards to forecast revenue scenarios and supported A/B test analysis. Used Microsoft Excel for pivot analyses and reporting templates; escalated action items through Jira.

Skills: SQL, Python 3, PowerBI, Microsoft Excel, pandas, Statistics, Jira
